summary: This Form 6-K reports a 1-for-31 reverse share consolidation by Zhongchao Inc., a Cayman Islands issuer, effective June 8, 2026. The consolidation, approved by shareholders on February 10, 2026 and the board on March 31, 2026, reduced Class A shares from ~79.7M to ~3.4M and Class B from ~625k to ~20k, with fractional shares rounded up. No price, premium, or advisor is mentioned; it is a purely mechanical capital structure adjustment to maintain Nasdaq listing compliance. This is not a special situation—no control change, no tender, no strategic event.
